pages.text: The Interior is richer than the Overworld. Its ores run in bigger veins: $(item)Rich Iron$() and $(item)Rich Copper$() in the crust, $(item)Rich Gold$() in the basalt of the Magma Chambers. Their chunks smelt to two ingots; assayed in the $(item)Spectrograph$() they give three each, and what rides with them in nature - magnetite with iron, gold with copper, uraninite with reef gold.

Its pockets of crystal are far larger than any geode: a shell of pale rock round masses of gem. $(item)Corundum$() and $(item)Garnet$() grow in the crust; $(item)Peridot$() in the mantle; and, rarer and deeper, $(item)Moissanite$(). Break a Crystal Mass for its gems; it takes silk touch to keep the mass whole.

Iron-Nickel and Core Magnetite Ore are too hard for any ordinary pick: they drop nothing to netherite. The $(item)Moissanite Drill$() - silicon carbide on a netherite shank - cuts them. Corundum is the lens material of the instruments to come.

$(thing)Basaltic Magma$() is far hotter than lava, and Fire Resistance is no help against it: it melts what it touches. Only armour made for it will do, and that comes later. $(thing)Deep Brine$() is scalding: it sets you alight like lava.
